items.t: Cracked plastic intake manifold coolant passage (4.6L)
items.job: Replace intake manifold and gaskets
items.note: Cost rises if the engine overheated after the coolant leak.

items.t: Takata driver airbag inflator (recall)
items.job: Replace driver airbag module
items.note: Covered by a Takata safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Water leaking onto the front floor
items.job: Clear cowl drains and reseal leak points
items.note: If water has damaged the fuse/junction box or wiring, the cost rises a lot.

items.t: Coolant loss into the cylinders (2.3L EcoBoost)
items.job: Replace engine short block
items.note: The block itself is the problem, so head gasket repairs rarely last. Ask a dealer about any goodwill help.

items.t: Hard shifting and grinding (MT82 manual)
items.job: Rebuild manual transmission synchronizers
items.note: A fluid change or shifter bushing sometimes helps for much less. A replacement transmission costs more.

items.t: Harsh or erratic shifts (10-speed automatic)
items.job: Replace transmission valve body and update software
items.note: A software update alone fixes some cars. Full transmission replacement costs much more.

items.t: Oil cooler hose separation (GT350 recall)
items.job: Replace engine oil cooler tube assembly
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: 10-speed automatic may not hold in Park (2018 recall)
items.job: Inspect and install transmission park roll pin
items.note: Free under recall 18V-213. Check the VIN first.

items.t: 10-speed automatic may not engage Park (2022-2023 recall)
items.job: Inspect and secure transmission park mechanism bolt
items.note: Free under recall 23V-070. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear suspension knuckle may have a casting flaw (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace rear suspension knuckle
items.note: Free under recall 24V-593. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Clutch line can melt against the exhaust on manual cars (recall)
items.job: Replace clutch pressure line and reroute away from exhaust
items.note: Free under recall 24V-394. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Engine bay wiring ground can break (recall)
items.job: Repair engine bay wiring ground connections
items.note: Free under recall 26V-547. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Cruise control cable can hold the throttle open (recall)
items.job: Replace cruise control cable and inspect throttle linkage
items.note: Free under recall 99V-062. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Parking brake can let go on manual cars (recall)
items.job: Replace parking brake self-adjust mechanism
items.note: Free under recall 00V-349. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front seat belt retractor pin may be faulty (recall)
items.job: Replace front seat belt retractor assembly
items.note: Free under recall 99V-250. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Accelerator pedal can catch on the carpet (Cobra recall)
items.job: Replace accelerator pedal assembly and trim carpet clearance
items.note: Free under recall 06V-108. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Timing chain guides wear out on the 4.0L V6
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Rear-mounted chain job on the 4.0L V6; engine often has to come out or be lifted.

items.t: Plastic thermostat housing cracks and leaks coolant
items.job: Replace thermostat housing and coolant

items.t: Rear axle pinion seal seeps gear oil
items.job: Replace rear axle pinion seal and refill gear oil

items.t: Paint blisters and rust on the hood and body seams
items.job: Strip, treat and repaint one panel
items.note: Body shop work; cost depends on the panel and paint match.

items.t: Front seat belt pretensioner cable can corrode and break (recall)
items.job: Replace front seat belt pretensioner
items.note: Free under recall 25V-614. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Backup camera picture is distorted or missing (recall)
items.job: Replace rear camera and repair wiring
items.note: Free under recalls 25V-572 and 22V-082. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Instrument cluster can come up blank (recall)
items.job: Reprogram or replace instrument cluster
items.note: Free under recalls 19V-076 and 26V-372. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Reverse lights, camera and driver aids can switch off on manual cars (recall)
items.job: Reprogram powertrain control module
items.note: Free under recall 22V-382. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Low brake fluid warning may never appear (recall)
items.job: Reprogram body control module
items.note: Free under recall 23V-727 or 25V-689. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Low-pressure fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump module
items.note: Free under recall 25V-455. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering can turn on its own from a sensor calibration fault (recall)
items.job: Recalibrate steering torque sensor
items.note: Free under recall 25V-096 or 24V-493. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Water can knock out the tail and marker lights (recall)
items.job: Replace rear lamp assemblies and seal wiring
items.note: Free under recall 25V-546. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Headlight driver modules can fail (recall)
items.job: Replace headlamp LED driver module
items.note: Free under recall 25V-519. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Wipers may only run on high and washers may not work in the cold (recall)
items.job: Replace wiper and washer control module
items.note: Free under recall 26V-418. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Piston faults can damage the engine (recall)
items.job: Inspect engine and replace short block if pistons are affected
items.note: Free under recall 26V-548 or 26V-205. Check the VIN first.

items.t: EGR valve can fail and cut engine power (recall)
items.job: Replace EGR valve
items.note: Free under recall 26V-122. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Spark plug can blow out of the cylinder head
items.job: Repair spark plug threads with a steel insert
items.note: Cost climbs fast if the head has to come off or the ejected plug damaged the coil and boot.

items.t: Fuel pump driver module fails and the car stalls
items.job: Replace fuel pump driver module
items.note: Budget a little extra if the connector is corroded and has to be repaired as well.
